## Disposition and credit

Record **30000773 / OWR-1543-004**, historical queue rank 1226, as a credited prior resolution for the original bounded-degree, ordinary-initialization attracting-edge question, including the triangle. The result is due to Codina Cotar and Debleena Thacker, [Annals of Probability 45(4) (2017), 2655–2706](https://doi.org/10.1214/16-AOP1122). The finite count-vector bound retains its Cotar–Limic attribution. **Zero new proof-search turns; no new solution or priority claim.**

The authored certificate, proof audit, and acceptance report are **AI-assisted and unrefereed**, with no proof-assistant certification. This status is distinct from the prior article's journal publication.

## Complete scoped mathematics

The accepted original target is almost-sure eventual alternation on one edge of a connected bounded-degree simple undirected graph with at least one edge, for arbitrary positive finite reciprocally summable, possibly nonmonotone reinforcement and common finite nonnegative integer initialization. The full mathematical text retains the finite count-vector induction for all finite shifted-summable offset configurations, the summable coercive function and second-largest-count bound, the finite-offset frontier product including its zero-index factor and incremented arrival edge, the n≥1 recurrence and both parity bases, and the confinement domination argument.

The inspected [arXiv v3 manuscript](https://arxiv.org/abs/1509.00807v3) contains a false lower bound in formula (36). The exact written example is retained: on the integer line with zero initial offsets and w(j)=10^j, forward fixation is at most 1/11, while the printed product is at least 7/36. **This is an estimate error, not a counterexample to attracting-edge fixation.** The full corrected proof needed for the finite-offset scope remains in the packet.

Arbitrary real edge-dependent offsets under conditions (6) and (8) remain theorem-cited but not independently proof-certified. The journal proof was unavailable for inspection, so no manuscript/journal identity or journal-error claim is made. Vertex reinforcement, directed edges, and arbitrary unbounded-degree graphs are outside the accepted scope.

## Edition contents

Adds exactly nine files under unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30000773/: README.md, PRIOR_APPLICABILITY_CERTIFICATE.md, PROOF_AUDIT.md, ACCEPTANCE_REPORT.md, SOURCE_LEDGER.md, VERIFICATION.json, STATUS.json, PROVENANCE.md, and MANIFEST.json. The proof audit is unchanged except for its explicit authorship-status banner; all its mathematics and limitations remain.

The edition includes authored mathematics, acceptance, public citations, public PDF identities, retrieval/inspection history, and certification boundaries. It excludes source-document bodies, extracts and images; dataset contents; scripts or checkers; standalone computational artifacts; and private coordination material. No excluded computation is substituted with prose. No QUEUE.md change is included.

Edition manifest SHA-256: 78ac4b8e3896476d8d0d1bcb51f973769540a7ddde9e932a413a98146e10b806.

Draft checkpoint only; no merge, release, DOI creation, or external outreach is requested.
